hook.rumour: In Mournhold's Great Bazaar, Indoril ordinators and Dres factors whisper that forged Temple quarantine writs are being used to seize caravan warehouses while Almalexia remains unseen.
hook.notice: PROCLAMATION OF GODSREACH & THE ROYAL PALACE — Capable investigators sought to verify the Quarantine Serk seals and inspect the Dwemer shafts beneath Bamz-Amschend.
hook.context: Deshaan is split between the orthodox Indoril priesthood of Mournhold, the royal Hlaalu court of King Helseth, and the slave-planters of Tear.

stages.objective: Examine the disputed Temple quarantine seals in Mournhold's Great Bazaar and Godsreach
Travel to Quarantine Serk and question the apothecaries about the falsified plague tallies
Verify the Hlaalu caravan bills with the council factors at Narsis

objectives.text: Examine the disputed Temple quarantine seals in Mournhold's Great Bazaar and Godsreach
Travel to Quarantine Serk and question the apothecaries about the falsified plague tallies
Verify the Hlaalu caravan bills with the council factors at Narsis

consequence_detail.summary: The Quarantine Serk apothecaries and Narsis factors confirm the plague writs were forged using an old Indoril signet stolen from Taldeic Fortress.

stages.objective: Question the Dres dock-stewards in Tear regarding the impounded grain barges
Locate the runaway shelter in Silent Mire where the honest Temple clerk took refuge
Have the mages at Shad Astula decipher the ciphered signet-ledger brought from Silent Mire

objectives.text: Question the Dres dock-stewards in Tear regarding the impounded grain barges
Locate the runaway shelter in Silent Mire where the honest Temple clerk took refuge
Have the mages at Shad Astula decipher the ciphered signet-ledger brought from Silent Mire

consequence_detail.summary: The scholars of Shad Astula break the cipher, revealing that a rogue Ordinator cabal has fortified Taldeic Fortress and the ruins under Mournhold.

stages.objective: Storm the outer watch-court of Taldeic Fortress and recover the stolen Indoril Signet-Ring
Descend into Bamz-Amschend beneath Mournhold and defeat the schismatic Ordinator prelate
Carry the recovered Indoril Signet-Ring back to Godsreach in Mournhold

objectives.text: Storm the outer watch-court of Taldeic Fortress and recover the stolen Indoril Signet-Ring
Descend into Bamz-Amschend beneath Mournhold and defeat the schismatic Ordinator prelate
Carry the recovered Indoril Signet-Ring back to Godsreach in Mournhold

consequence_detail.summary: The schismatic prelate in Bamz-Amschend is defeated and the stolen Indoril signet is returned to the surface of Mournhold.

stages.objective: Silence the last hired Dres mercenaries gathered at Eidolon's Hollow
Deliver the full evidence before the Royal Palace and Temple High Fane in Mournhold
Receive the joint commendation of Godsreach and the Royal Court of Mournhold

objectives.text: Silence the last hired Dres mercenaries gathered at Eidolon's Hollow
Deliver the full evidence before the Royal Palace and Temple High Fane in Mournhold
Receive the joint commendation of Godsreach and the Royal Court of Mournhold

consequence_detail.summary: The false quarantine seizures end across Deshaan, the Silent Mire refugees are granted sanctuary, and Mournhold's markets reopen in full.
